summary: Full frontend-only review of ALT&ACT static React (HashRouter) site. Validated the new editorial content on the homepage (hero signature + 3 CTAs + 4 repères + agir-avec section + je-suis section + prevention teaser), the two new pages (/#/agir-avec-vous with 6 profils, sticky nav, 6 CTAs + anchor scroll; /#/prevenir-les-ruptures with publics, limites, orientation, 2 CTAs), the Mission dropdown (desktop + mobile mobile-menu-toggle), the footer slogan, the contact subject options, and regression on existing pages. All data-testid elements are present. All CTAs route to the correct URL. Zero console errors / warnings observed on homepage, both new pages, and the regression pages.
critical_code_review_comments: URL after appui-btn becomes '/#/agir-avec-vous#personne' – a double-hash under HashRouter. It works thanks to AgirAvecVous.jsx reading location.hash, but it is non-standard; consider using state or query params for anchor scroll to improve clarity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is HashRouter + Formspree, no backend. All critical data-testid confirmed working: hero-signature, hero-intro, discover-btn, appui-btn, cooperer-btn, hero-reperes, repere-{dignite,service,universalite,unite}, contribution-formula, agir-avec-section, agir-avec-texte, mission-{ecouter,informer,developper,relier}, je-suis-section, je-suis-{personne,professionnel,entreprise,association,institution,recherche}, prevention-teaser, prevention-teaser-btn, presentation-section, agir-avec-vous-page, profil-{6}, profil-nav-{6}, profil-cta-{6}, profils-nav, agir-contact-btn, prevenir-ruptures-page, prevention-publics (5 cards), limites-section, ce-que-nous-faisons (8 items), ce-que-nous-ne-faisons-pas (6 items), orientation-bloc (quote OK), prevention-contact-btn, prevention-jesuis-btn, mission-dropdown, agir-avec-vous-link, prevenir-ruptures-link, mobile-menu-toggle. Form submission intentionally NOT performed (Formspree real).
